analytic_formula_review: Partitioning binary configurations by the two counts gives the stated elementary-symmetric normalizer exactly.
Conditioned on both counts, the two sides factorize into unary-weighted fixed-size subsets; root-count and backward-subset draws give the stated joint law.

For an equal four-component factorial Bernoulli law, total covariance is expected conditional Bernoulli variance plus covariance of component means. The stated diag(d)+VV^T is exact and yields mu*(1-mu) on the diagonal.
The arbitrary cross-count potential pays full count-grid work; nested recursive-cardinality FFT complexity is not imported.
Different model RNG consumption invalidates same-seed realized-mask equality; retained hash identities do not reconstruct draws.
